name: Mentoring software hero with wide image and load reveal
purpose: Open the mentoring product page with a wide hero image, the H1, the people-first pitch and video/demo CTAs, plus a customer-logo line.
description: A wide hero image (150% of the container, 35rem tall, black-to-transparent top fade) pulled up -8rem under the nav, then a centred block overlapping it by 3rem: avatar strip + trust line, two-line serif H1 (h1 token), 20px grey copy (lead line + paragraph), brand-blue primary and dark buttons; then a logo lead line and 6 logos. <=767 the image becomes an in-flow 3:2 card with radius and buttons stack <=479.
